match.userMessage: When I say 'start the issue pipeline': chat with me to gather context about the issue, draft a plan and wait for my approval — remind me if I forget, give up after 3 days — then implement it, and redo it based on my feedback, at most 5 times.

toolCalls.name: pipeline_definition
toolCalls.arguments: {"name":"issue-pipeline","trigger":{"kind":"command","phrase":"start the issue pipeline"},"stages":[{"id":"gather-context","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Chat with the user to gather context about the issue. Ask clarifying questions to understand the problem, its scope, any constraints, and the desired outcome. Keep the conversation going until you have enough information to draft a solid plan."},{"id":"draft-plan","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Using the context gathered in the previous stage, draft a clear, detailed plan for resolving the issue. The plan should outline the steps, any risks or trade-offs, and the expected outcome.","output":{"kind":"plan"}},{"id":"approve-plan","kind":"gate","instructions":"Review the drafted plan above.
